parameters.Delta_1: Normalized input perturbation level ||x - x_clean|| / ||x_clean|| in [0, 1] (dimensionless)
parameters.E_l: Downstream misclassification / error rate at layer l in [0, 1] (dimensionless)
parameters.EAF_l: Error Amplification Factor (dimensionless sensitivity condition number)

regime_interpretations.EAF > 1.0: Pipeline acts as an error amplifier (downstream error exceeds upstream perturbation)
regime_interpretations.EAF = 0.0: Complete fail-closed containment (zero corrupted payloads reach downstream layers)
